subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept bare `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` as session-naming shortcuts, or should naming stay behind `/name` or an explicit named-new syntax?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but the permanent command grammar overlaps existing `/new [model]` and the merged `/name <title>` direction.

options.title: Keep closed until sponsored
options.body: Close this contributor PR as unconfirmed product direction and let a maintainer reopen, sponsor, or request a replacement once the command grammar is chosen.

options.title: Accept Control UI shortcuts
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or sponsor this PR and accept the documented Control UI-specific `/new <text>` and `/label` behavior.

options.title: Require explicit syntax
options.body: Ask for a replacement that keeps bare `/new` expectations and uses `/name`, `/label`, or `/new --name` explicitly.
